tool.title: Validate a node in the graph
tool.description: Check one file against the schema for its graph typology. ONE tool for every schema: the kind is resolved from the declared directory that holds the file.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The node to check. Its graph typology is resolved from the declared directory that contains it.

inputs.name: lenient
inputs.description: Accept partial coverage knowingly: downgrade could-not-determine from an error to a warning.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: One line per file — valid, invalid with the failing paths, or could-not-determine with the reason. Exit 0 valid, 1 invalid or undetermined, 2 misuse.

selection.when: Whenever a node's shape matters and you are not in this repository's CI: `tools/` is an INHERITED declaration and `.github/workflows/` is not, so a downstream layer gets this and none of the CI gates.
selection.limits: It can only check a kind that declares a validator; a node of any other kind comes back UNDETERMINED and it exits non-zero saying so. `bun run cat check:kind-validators` reports the coverage.
selection.cost: One module import per kind. Nothing to install, no network.

$comment.comment:
`Text`, not a bespoke verdict type: the tool's answer is the exit
code plus one line per file, and minting a type for "three states
and a reason" would be a vocabulary entry with one user.

The FIRST tool bound to this skill. Measured 2026-09-20: of ten Tool
nodes, none validated anything and none named `kg-navigation`, while
199 Zod schemas sat unreachable from the graph (bean `3lbz`).
